mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals strong labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 50k and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), policy rate hikes compress corporate profit margins and increase discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1100 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes increased corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST exceeds 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and decrease in industrial production indicates a demand-supply mismatch, where strong housing demand outstrips manufacturing capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 50k and INDPRO decreases by at least 1.0 index point.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures indicates robust consumer demand that precedes higher corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.
